desc: Implement the solution: split nums at threshold, build DSU over labels 1..threshold, union each present x <= threshold with its multiples m (2x, 3x, ... <= threshold), count distinct roots among present values <= threshold, add one per value > threshold
Run provided examples + randomized brute-force cross-check (pairwise math.lcm union-find) to confirm the shared-common-multiple reduction is correct; both examples PASS and zero mismatches observed
Validate O(T log T) performance with T = 2e5 and n = 1e5 worst case, confirming runtime/memory are acceptable
Confirm correctness proof and edge cases (T=1, single element, value == threshold, all values > threshold)
